ops.text: runner-latency-1, Nov 3: `gh api repos/yasyf/cc-skills/actions/jobs/<id>/logs` wrote 0-byte files for every failed job of run 41589239217 (the logs endpoint answers with a redirect to blob storage, which the read-only `gh` rewrite to `ccx vcs gh` seems not to follow), so the failure looked log-less; `gh run view <run> --log-failed` returned the 1,975-line log. Fix: have `ccx vcs gh` follow the logs redirect or refuse that endpoint naming `gh run view --log-failed`.
